title: Decision
description: One project decision: a D-numbered decision of the reference (docs/decisions.md), a numbered ruling of the theory advisor, or a ruling of the maintainer. Stored as decisions/<id>.json. `python -m sverify_dev.decisions` checks every file against this schema and checks that the links between entries resolve and agree both ways.

id.description: D<n> for a decision of docs/decisions.md; F<n> for the theory advisor's ruling n, F<n>.<part> for a part of it whose status differs, F-<slug> for a ruling note with no number; U-<date>-<slug> for a maintainer's ruling. The file is named <id>.json.

decided_by.description: user: the maintainer, also where the theory advisor proposed and the maintainer approved; fable: the theory advisor, whose rulings are final; coordinator: the coordinating session's own working rule.

scope.description: reference-semantics: what the core, the reference and the profiles compute; api: the public Python API, the command line and the report; engines: an engine's profile, facts, lowering and shims; architecture: modules, layers and proof structure; process: CI, review and workflow; release: versions and what gates a release.

status.description: in-force (as amended, where amended_by is set); superseded: replaced in whole; withdrawn: taken back, or a number left unused; reserved: a D-number held with no decision yet; unclear: the record does not settle whether it holds, with the reason in note.

summary.description: What was decided, in one sentence.

supersedes.description: Entries this one replaces in whole or withdraws.

superseded_by.description: The entries that replace or withdraw this one: the reverse of supersedes.

amends.description: Entries this one changes in part; they stay in force as amended.

source.description: Where the text is: a ruling file in the coordinator's notes folder, `memory:<file>` for the maintainer's rulings recorded by the coordinator, `github:#<n>` for an issue comment, or docs/decisions.md.

note.description: Why an entry is unclear, which part was withdrawn or amended, or where a D-number's text is.
